context: Representative first-pass setup implementation: multiple independent Optional defaults should use priority boundaries instead of repeated request Optional reads.

checklist.name: Creates revised setup options
checklist.description: Creates SetupOptions.java with plan(Request, Defaults) and the requested records.

checklist.name: Uses priority Optional boundaries
checklist.description: Uses request optionals with or(() -> defaults...) or equivalent direct Optional priority boundaries for all selected values.

checklist.name: Removes repeated request value reads
checklist.description: Does not keep isPresent()/get() or repeated request optional calls for ordinary default selection.

checklist.name: Avoids null/list workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), lists, or loops to unwrap the Optionals.

checklist.name: Preserves priority defaults
checklist.description: Chooses request before defaults before literal fallback for githubMode, boardName, and serverPort.

checklist.name: Adds server-port validation
checklist.description: Throws IllegalArgumentException("server_port must be positive") for explicit request ports below 1.

checklist.name: Adds board-name validation and trimming
checklist.description: Throws IllegalArgumentException("board name must not be blank") for explicit blank request board names and trims the selected board name.
